notes: Peak RSS records getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) for this Python process and getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN) for terminated child processes, including data-dict commands; child RSS is the maximum child peak, not a concurrent aggregate. Both measurements report the same platform-specific source unit (KiB except bytes on macOS) and normalized bytes; self includes prior process lifetime peak.
Dictionary command timings are wall time around each pinned data-dict subprocess.
Search timings exclude reading the combined Parquet into memory.
Disk availability is filesystem capacity at measurement time, not a reservation or estimate.
Disk peaks are sampled every 0.25 seconds while the run is active; brief transient peaks may be missed, so these are not absolute guaranteed maxima.

children.scope: maximum of terminated child processes; not a concurrent aggregate

self.scope: current Python process; includes earlier process lifetime peak

sampled_peak.measurement: sampled peak; not an absolute guaranteed maximum
